stories.title: Is the stock market open for Thanksgiving? The answer might surprise you.
stories.summary: The answer to the question of whether the stock market is open on Thanksgiving isn’t a simple yes or no, as the major exchanges are closed, but trading of equity futures is open for part of the day.

stories.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
stories.summary: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue. stories.zh_title: 據報道，亞馬遜正在商談終止 Muse AI 購物街區
stories.zh_summary: 根據《財星》雜誌報道，亞馬遜已就讓 Meta 的 Muse AI 代理商在其線上市場上購物進行了談判。據報道，討論可能會結束亞馬遜對 Muse 的封鎖，討論的重點是人工智慧代理推薦的產品種類以及對這家電子商務巨頭的潛在影響。

stories.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
stories.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.
stories.zh_title: 據報道，亞馬遜和 Meta 正在談判解除對人工智慧代理 Muse 的封鎖
stories.zh_summary: 亞馬遜和 Meta 正在討論一項可能的交易，該交易將結束 Muse 長達兩個月的封鎖。

stories.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
stories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 稱將人類控制權交給人工智慧的指控“荒謬”
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 反駁了競爭對手的指控，稱他傾向於將人類代理權交給人工智慧，儘管領先的人工智慧公司越來越多地自動化自己的研究和模型開發。

stories.title: Why this stock-market selloff is probably going to get worse before it gets better
stories.summary: Monday’s rally helped to paper over deeper issues that must be resolved before a durable bottom can arrive.
stories.zh_title: 為什麼股市的拋售在好轉之前可能會變得更糟
stories.zh_summary: 週一的上漲有助於掩蓋更深層的問題，這些問題必須在持久底部到來之前解決。

stories.title: Oracle, CoreWeave and other tech stocks bounce back after selloff
stories.summary: Oracle, CoreWeave and other technology stocks bounced back from early losses on Wednesday, after what appeared to be a major selloff eased ahead of the market’s close.
stories.zh_title: 甲骨文、CoreWeave 和其他科技股在拋售後反彈
stories.zh_summary: 甲骨文、CoreWeave 和其他科技股週三從早盤跌幅中反彈，此前市場收盤前的大幅拋售有所緩解。

stories.zh_summary: 去年，谷歌為名為「我的頻道」的系統申請了專利，該系統旨在根據該公司了解的用戶資訊創建充滿個人化、人工智慧生成的影片和廣告的提要。該專利已被駁回，但不幸的是，谷歌可能會上訴或重新提交專利申請

stories.title: HP’s stock is a standout gainer in the tech selloff, as an earnings beat still matters
stories.summary: PC maker’s ‘low-quality’ beat is enough to propel its shares amid the tech rout.
stories.zh_title: 惠普股票在科技股拋售中表現突出，因為獲利好於預期仍然很重要
stories.zh_summary: 這家個人電腦製造商的「低品質」表現足以在科技股大跌之際推動其股價上漲。

stories.title: Tech stocks sink but close well off the lows, Anthropic struggles to rebound above IPO price
stories.summary: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.
stories.zh_title: 科技股下跌，但收盤遠離低點，Anthropic 難以反彈至 IPO 價格以上
stories.zh_summary: 由於投資者權衡人工智慧支出、通膨和利率上升風險，英偉達和其他人工智慧相關股票下跌。

stories.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
stories.summary: Kalshi traders have cut the odds of OpenAI confirming an IPO before June 2027, as AI stocks and related markets have weakened.
stories.zh_title: 預測市場將 OpenAI IPO 預期推至 2027 年晚些時候
stories.zh_summary: 由於人工智慧股票和相關市場走軟，Kalshi 交易員降低了 OpenAI 在 2027 年 6 月之前確認 IPO 的可能性。

stories.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
stories.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
stories.zh_title: 標準普爾警告英偉達信用評等可能因「上升」的管理和治理風險而被下調
stories.zh_summary: 標準普爾全球評級表示，英偉達的信用評級可能會被下調一級，因為它指出這家晶片製造商的管理和治理風險「上升」。

stories.title: South Korea's Kospi leads gains as tech rebound lifts Asia markets
stories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.21% in early trade, while the Topix edged 0.71% higher. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was up 0.15%.
stories.zh_title: 科技股反彈提振亞洲市場，韓國綜合股價指數領漲
stories.zh_summary: 日本日經 225 指數早盤上漲 1.21%，東證指數小漲 0.71%。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数上涨 0.15%。
